last.verdict: Record revenue came from Alani Nu's surge, but the flagship CELSIUS brand shrank again and falling margins left adjusted profit per share slightly down.

takeaways.label: Alani Nu carries growth
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 17% to $847M. Alani Nu grew 24% to $410M, while the flagship CELSIUS brand fell about 6% to $357M.

takeaways.label: Margins keep sliding
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 46.8% against 51.3% a year earlier, as aluminum and fuel costs and more sales through PepsiCo's delivery network weighed. Adjusted EPS slipped to $0.41 from $0.42.

takeaways.label: CELSIUS brand still weak
takeaways.text: CELSIUS retail sales fell 7% and its U.S. share was 9.1%. The company blames fewer products and weak club-store sales, and named a new brand president.

takeaways.label: International momentum
takeaways.text: International sales jumped 78% to $41M, but that is only about 5% of total revenue.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
